continuation_contract.terminal_hold_rows: 5 once at whole-plan end, not per chunk
continuation_contract.cache: immutable validated full rows; plan_id, cursor, state, expected episode/step and boundary snapshot, world/source/policy identities
continuation_contract.execution: expected_cursor=0 at first call; exact returned cursor on continuation; duplicate/skip refuses without motion
continuation_contract.continuation: only after successful internal chunk; exact saved episode/step and unchanged boundary q,qvel,qcmd,jaws/world/source/policy; preserve velocity and original remaining timing, no inserted settle/IK reset
continuation_contract.ownership: reserve current plan across paused chunks; state/preview/memory reads allowed; interleaved physical mutation invalidates plan
continuation_contract.final_result: only full trajectory completion may report command_completed/goal_reached under existing measured tolerances
continuation_contract.failure: STOP/tracking/callback/execution/budget/episode failure is terminal, cursor cannot resume; no automatic old-target hold recovery
continuation_contract.budget: each chunk consumes action-call count; actual chunk rows preflight against50-row policy and remaining episode allowance
continuation_contract.validation: retime complete plan within total cap and revalidate final resampled edges; do not globally relax fresh-start/stale/guard thresholds

stage_C: Focused cursor,duplicate/skip,boundary continuity,staleness,STOP,budget,terminal and callback/error tests
Complete full slow paths with bounded continuation
Full unchanged scene small/intermediate/near-box STANDOFF repeatability, both-arm coverage and existing goal tolerances
Guard failures remain failures; preserve evidence and source hashes
reporting: timestamped substantive milestones with exact source,commands,evidence and limitations; no need to wait for queued multipart messages

monitor_review_findings.correction: Only release ownership if invalidated plan_id is the owner. Previewing/executing another stale cached plan must not release paused owner
monitor_review_findings.tests: cache A+B; execute A to pause; preview/execute stale B; A remains owner, new planning busy

latest_user_instruction: Now I need to fix every problem in this motion planning. I do not want only folding-box testing; use several small tests to solve specific problems.

validation_program.principle: Several small deterministic tests, each isolating a failure mode with explicit acceptance/refusal gates; fix and rerun affected checks. Separate mocked/unit contracts, real full-scene planner queries, and actual motor-driven execution. No full-fold proxy success.

cases.checks: Both7-joint arms, named indices, metres/radians, active wxyz/sign equivalence, TCP local transform; FK matches measured simulator pose. Do not substitute virtual TCP for pads.

Small deterministic5-10mm +/-axis goals from settled starts on both arms; choose preview-validated free-space cases, log actual displacement/endpoint and inactive-arm/jaw stability; invalid directions remain explicit refusal, not counted as success.

Small orientation-only reachable goals; malformed quaternion/frame/arm inputs and joint-limit/unreachable/time-exhausted cases refuse with no physics. No global impossibility claim from budget exhaustion.
Frozen same-path original/half/quarter speed full completion/guard-stop comparisons; motor-substep telemetry, reference clipping, timing. Small repeatability set, no unbounded sweep.
49/50/51 rows plus82/164 multi-chunk cases; total500-row bound and501 refusal; no duplicate/skipped trajectory rows, timing discontinuity or per-chunk terminal holds.
Mandatory explicit expected cursor for continuation; duplicate/skipped requests0motion and0action-budget use; stale B cannot release paused A; terminal plans never resume.

Preview/scratch-state refusal probes for table,self,opposite-arm,jaws,cardboard/thin-edge crossings; log checked/excluded pairs and clearance assumptions. Do not physically execute colliding candidates. No continuous-collision certification from finite samples.

Episode/step/source/policy/world change, external q/qvel/qcmd/jaw mutation, fresh unsettled/mismatched start refuse; exact internal chunk boundary may preserve ongoing velocity. Preview/state tools do not advance physics.

STOP during search,chunk,and between chunks; record actual latency and next-row suppression. Callback/worker/sampler exceptions clean up; sampler restores original mj_step. Tracking stop has no automatic hold/reference reset.
Per-call50 cap, total-plan bound, action-call count and episode/wall limits including final chunk; refused duplicate spends no action budget; native done/truncated and audit/result agree.
Real discovered tool schema->validation->backend->service->motor control; long-plan cursor/budget/refusal results and traces consistent. No cloud needed.

Few small/intermediate/near-box STANDOFF moves for both arms with repeated successful measured goals under unchanged tracking/clearance/warning/other-arm/jaw guards. No contact or cardboard-free-only proof.

validation_program.reporting: One machine-readable suite index: caseID,status(pass/fail/refused-as-expected/unsupported/not-run), source/config hashes, evidence paths, measured errors/clearance/rows,timing,motor saturation and exact refusal/stop. Real motion vs synthetic checks separately labeled. Keep unresolved failures visible; do not remove tests or loosen guards to pass.
validation_program.acceptance: Existing actual goal<=5mm/0.05rad, joint tracking<=0.02rad, unchanged collision/other-arm/jaw limits, zero forbidden contacts/warnings; all required failure/STOP/cursor cases fail closed. No grasp/folding success claim.
